mcp:tool-listener.name: list-alerts
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists the surveillance alerts (insider-trading suspicions), highest score first: alert ID, score (0-100), status (未対応 / 調査中 / 承認待ち / 問題なし / 深掘り / 保留 / 当局報告), raised date, customer and instrument. Give status to list only the alerts in that status.

mcp:tool-listener.name: get-alert
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns everything about one surveillance alert in a single call: the score and its reasons, the customer profile (occupation, employer, income, experience), the instrument, the announcement (material fact) the trades came before, every trade of the customer in that instrument, the customer's 10 latest trades, the customer's entries in the insider registry, and past surveillance cases of the same kind with their decisions. The alert ID looks like SV-0001; "0001" or "1" is accepted too. Returns {"found": false} when there is no such alert.

mcp:tool-listener.name: request-approval
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Saves the investigation of this conversation and sends the recommendation with the investigation memo to the approval inbox, where an employee decides. The memo is built from the fields given here, so give facts only. Returns {"status": "requested", "approvalId": ...}, or "already_pending" / "already_decided" / "not_found" / "failed" with the reason.

db:select.db:sql: select a.alert_id, a.kind, a.status, c.name as customer_name, i.name as instrument_name from max.alerts a join max.customers c using (customer_id) join max.instruments i using (code) where a.alert_id = :id
select approval_id from max.approvals where target_id = :id and status = '承認待ち'
